The low Return on Equity (ROE) over the last three years at 7.99% could also indicate underperformance relative to peers and benchmarks, which is a negative factor [E62]. However, these factors are outweighed by the positive aspects of the stock, making it a compelling investment opportunity despite its current valuation.
